name: Swiss
pitch: An argument-driven engineering talk set like a Zurich concert poster: grid, grotesk, one red.

illustration.medium: flat vector, Swiss International Style poster graphic on off-white
illustration.line: 2px hairline rules, dead straight, grid-aligned, no taper
illustration.shapes: rectangles, circles, and one diagonal or grid element, strict alignment, generous negative space
illustration.palette_use: off-white background dominant, black type, one red used sparingly as the single accent
illustration.avoid: gradients, drop shadows, rounded corners, decoration, more than one accent color
